## Episode Thesis

This is an episode of VG's Pengerådet, a Norwegian personal-finance podcast, about the government's 2027 state budget proposal. Topics covered are oil fund spending, the Norgespris electricity price going up from 40 to 45 øre, cuts to the EV VAT exemption, small income tax relief, changes to wealth tax, student support tied to the basic amount, and letting Euronext Growth/MTF shares into the share savings account (aksjesparekonto). No listed companies are discussed as investments, and the episode carries no equity market view; only sponsors (Kiwi, Podimo) and analysis firm Volue are mentioned in passing.
